observation.description: Search-index visibility in v1 accepts only {kind:'public-read'} or {kind:'owner', field} where the owner field is matched against the effective principal. The Linear-shaped product fact — full-text search over the ORGANIZATION'S issues, visible to any org member — is inexpressible: public-read would disclose issue text to outsiders (a Stop-class shape), and owner partitions only reach rows assigned to the caller. The arm shipped the honest subset ('search my issues' on assigneeId, which passed with term/prefix/highlights and per-principal partition negatives) and recorded org-wide member search as an explicit GAP. The guide documents the restriction ('Membership and relation-derived visibility are not accepted in v1'), so this is a capability gap, not a defect.

competitorOutcome.description: Convex full-text search indexes run inside ordinary query functions, so membership gating composes with search by construction (official docs); the frozen Firebase Linear arm had NO native full-text search at all and recorded LINEAR-09 as a GAP requiring an external provider.

mustNotRegress: The authorization-partition property: a caller can never receive a posting outside its declared partition, and search visibility never silently widens; deterministic ranking and the AEAD cursor custody stay.
smallestCoherentFix: A membership visibility kind for search indexes — visibility: { kind: 'membership', membership: '<declaration>', resource: '<field>' } — resolving the caller's seats inside the same transaction the posting recheck already runs in, so a search query is pushed into the union of the caller's resource partitions.
acceptanceWitness: An org member's search over the seeded issues returns cross-assignee matches with highlights; an outsider's identical query returns zero rows with no disclosure; revoking the seat makes the next search return zero.
